texts.title:
Percent of Occupational Therapists
(Female/Male): 2008
texts.source:
According to the Federal Bureau of Labor Statistics the percent ratio of gender for
occupational therapists are 24 females for every male (24:1). Compare that number with
other healthcare professions. (i.e. physical therapist (3:1) female to male ratio)
(www.bls.gov/cps/cpsaat11.pdf)
